data.title: FC Nordsjælland vs Panathinaikos Preview 11/26/2026 | Forebet
data.content: FC Nordsjælland are expected to return closer to their strongest 3-4-3 after rotating parts of the side in Monaco. Andreas Hansen should continue in goal, Tobias Salquist is central to the back three if passed fit, and Adel’s recent scoring contribution makes him hard to leave out. Hjalte Boe is pushing strongly for a front-three place after an excellent domestic run. [...] Panathinaikos are expected to keep Iñaki Peña in goal, with Calabria, de Vrij, Van Drongelen and Georgios Kyriakopoulos forming the back four. Anass Salah-Eddine, Sverrir Ingi Ingason, Moussa Sissoko, Azzedine Ounahi, Pavlos Pantelidis and Lucas Chaves are not part of the current European selection, while Dessers should compete with Elmin Rastoder for the center-forward role. Dessers’ European scoring record keeps him the likelier focal point. [...] FC Nordsjælland probable XI: Andreas Hansen; Noah Markmann, Tobias Salquist, Juho Lähteenmäki; Peter Ankersen, Justin Janssen, Nicklas Røjkjær, Runar Norheim; Ibrahim Adel, Alexander Lind, Hjalte Boe.
